Chapter 6763: Tides Saber

Chapter 6763: Tides Saber

“Dracowrath!” A big shot at the king level recognized the saber.

“Venerable Dragon Kingdom’s heirloom!” All eyes were on the rumored-to-be-missing weapon.

In this world, weapons had grades equal to cultivators and beasts. The strongest weapons were known as divine artifacts made from the proper metals, capable of controlling beasts.

However, Dracowrath was different and superior to other divine artifacts. Rumor has it that it was made from the bone of a supreme divine beast, the source of all celestial beasts.

The inhabitants of this world knew their divine beasts wouldn’t be classified as such elsewhere in Heaven Realm. The exception was this ancient beast, a creature far beyond anything their world could produce.

After being killed by Empress Hong Tian, only three bones were found; all refined into divine artifacts.

Dracowrath was one of them. Its appearance incited greed, but none dared to act. Although Venerable Dragon was on a decline, it was still under Rainbow’s protection.

“Venerable Dragon Lord, may I take a look at the saber?” A handsome youth asked boldly.

His armor shimmered with rippling waves of radiance. By merely standing there, he gave the impression of being enveloped by endless seas. His aura surged forward like crashing waves.

“Tides Monarch.” Many recognized him.

Those who hadn’t seen him before were still intimidated upon discovering his identity.

“From Sky Zenith.” Many stared at the lord.

This was a young genius at the king level. Most importantly, he was a direct disciple of Emerald Grand Emperor.

Sky Zenith was the oldest lineage in Beastmaster, perhaps stronger than Rainbow and Yellow Sky combined.

“Will he give it up?” Many stared at Venerable Dragon Lord.

“It’s not up to him.” A king beastmaster said.

Tides Monarch didn’t have the same qualms as others since he didn’t fear Rainbow Kingdom.

“I’m afraid I can’t oblige.” Venerable Dragon Lord said.

“My Lord, I have long heard of your kingdom’s famed saber. Today, I humbly ask that you grant me a small favor of borrowing it.” The youth came closer while laughing heartily and sending his aura forward.

The lord's expression soured since the youth clearly wanted to use force. He glanced back at Li Qiye and Xiaoyue; both completely ignored the youth.

“Fellow Daoist, Dracowrath has a master already, it is not for anyone to see.” The lord said confidently since he had immortals as his backers.

“My Lord, don’t choose the hard way over...” The youth didn’t appreciate the refusal.

“Thank you, but no.” The lord interrupted.

“I suppose I will have to see its power today then.” The youth summoned his saber - another of the water affinity.

“Please give me pointers.” He said, using the saber to control a tides crab.

“So be it.” The lord’s weapon was a shovel with immense weight. It was used to control his mountain-mover beast.

“Tides Summon!” The youth swung his saber, creating a towering tsunami.

A massive shadow came out of the waves and stood before him - a radiant crab. It immediately attacked with its razor-sharp pincers capable of snipping mountains.
